summary: Hoopa-area 1930s observation cabin on an 80-foot timber tower, removed before 1986; the summit now hosts a county radio site under a Hoopa Valley Tribe license.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The county report calls the site Sugar Pine Mountain in its title and most of its text, but once refers to the 'Sugar Hill Mountain site'. The story flags that the match is by name and location only: the report gives no coordinates, so it cannot confirm that both names mean the same summit.

notes_for_editor: Thin record: one register page and one county staff report. The register gives no staff names, fire events or dated photos beyond 1937. A Facebook group post gives 1937 as the build year; it was not used. The Forest Lookouts Sugar Pine page has no lookout text beyond its header, so it is not cited. The county report does not give coordinates, so whether its radio site stands on the old lookout footprint is open. The record's 1930 build year is replaced with a 1930s range. Height 24.4 m comes from the register's 80-foot figure.
